## Superseded
Whizz's 2GIS window now calls the official Catalog API directly from the Worker (discover2Gis() in worker/routes/leadIntelligence.js, POST /api/lead-intelligence/discover/2gis) instead of this workflow — the Apify actor below needed a residential proxy plan to get past 2GIS's anti-bot wall (confirmed live: `twogis: transport failure: ProxyError`), which the direct API sidesteps entirely. This workflow is kept only as a reference/fallback if you'd rather scrape than set a TWOGIS_API_KEY secret; it is not wired to anything by default anymore.

## Setup checklist
1. Open **Call Apify 2GIS Actor** → Authentication is set to Predefined Credential Type → Apify API. Click the credential dropdown and select/create your Apify credential there (no token pasted in code anywhere).
2. Actor ID in **Build Apify Request** is `thenetaji~2gis-search-scraper` (apify.com/thenetaji/2gis-search-scraper) — searches by query+city. A real test run against the sibling `2gis-place-scraper` actor confirmed THAT one needs `placeIds` (a deep-enrichment-by-ID actor, not search), which is why it was swapped.
3. **Confirmed live**: a real execution returned `Input is not valid: Field input.cities is required` for a `city` (singular string) field, so **Build Apify Request** now sends `cities: [location]` (an array) instead. `queries`/`maxItems` are still an unconfirmed best-effort guess — apify.com is unreachable from the environment this was drafted in. Run a test execution; if it errors again, open the actor's "API" or "Input" tab on Apify for the exact field names and edit **Build Apify Request** to match, then share the error/output here if you want help fixing it.
4. **Map to Whizz Contacts** tries several likely field names per contact (title/name, phone/phoneNumber/phones[0], etc.) since the actor's exact output field names are equally unverified — adjust there too if real output looks different. It now also captures a stable `sourceId` (id/placeId/2gisId/fid) and `countryCode`/`city` — Whizz uses `sourceId`+platform to detect "already imported" listings and refresh them (rating, phone) instead of just dropping them as a duplicate, and uses the country signal so leads land under the right country in Lead Intelligence instead of "Unknown".
5. `maxItems` now allows up to 100 per run (was 50) — 2GIS's own result pages go well past 20, so a low cap under-collects on broad categories/cities. Raise `APIFY_2GIS_HARD_CAP` in the Build Apify Request code below if your actor plan can take more.

Whizz calls this at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-discover-2gis with body {query, location, brand, category, limit} and expects back {"contacts":[{name,phone,email,website,address,totalScore,url,sourceId,countryCode,city}]}.
